claims.explanation: The original problem has $-17 + 3$ inside the absolute value, not $-17 - 3$. Changing the $+3$ to $-3$ alters the quantity being evaluated.
The absolute value of $-20$ is $20$, not $14$. If the expression really were $-17 - 3$, the right side would be $20$.
From $2x + 4 = 14$, subtracting $4$ from both sides gives $2x = 10$, not $2x = 18$.
